changes.identity: ALEPH standard human versus Aspect, Recreation, True AI Host / Heritage; distinct from physical Lhost or human Posthuman.
changes.foundation: AI hosts use the Homeworld/Habitat selector as Psychogenetic Foundation; fixed +1 main attributes and +1 subskill applied as effective modifiers, preserving underlying ratings; Eclectic manual.
changes.careers: 14 ALEPH faction careers; 16 distinct AI careers from separate AI table; conditional Career filtering and source profile metadata.
changes.lifepaths: 20 adolescent, 20 ALEPH career, 20 AI career events; AI host/origin, status, aspect traits, education, Geas and Insurrection references.
changes.gear: 42 Chapter 5 table entries (source pp.72–73), preserve custom legacy descriptions on enriched items and correct source classifications.
changes.references: Dedicated ALEPH Source References in glossary including Lhosts, Geist Lifepath, Infowar and source notes.
changes.compatibility: V71 Nomad uplift, V70 PanO Helot, Ariadna Dogface, Haqq/Yu Jing career mapping, browser saves, XML and sheet custom rules preserved.

sourceExceptions: The printed AI career table's 'Tactical Remote Pilot' corresponds to the Chapter 3 profile 'Tactical Remote Presence Pilot'. Use one selectable label while preserving the printed variant.
The source career profiles print 'Teck', 'Theivery', 'Anaylsis' and 'Persuasion' in some elective/mandatory rows. Normalised to Tech, Thievery, Analysis and Persuade matching the sheet's skill names.

Bureau Toth Agent and Sophotect appear on the ALEPH career table, but their individual profile special lines say O-12 Faction prerequisite. Both conflicting source facts are preserved for GM adjudication; no invented resolution.

Recreations may serve non-ALEPH factions and True AIs may originate elsewhere; the simplified single-faction sheet offers the AI host options through ALEPH selections, with cross-faction play handled as an explicit GM exception.
ALEPH source career events and AI events are separate d20 tables. No random effect or Life Point cost is silently imposed by selecting a career.
Homeworld / Habitat field functions as Psychogenetic Foundation only when an ALEPH AI host is chosen. Existing human ALEPH homes and legacy imports remain valid.
Lhost gear is not assumed to mean an AI host is currently embodied; physical body and software identity remain distinct.

checks: Adolescent / Faction Career / AI Career events 20 each
